page.title: Bank connections
page.description: Sync transactions straight from your bank instead of entering them by hand.

empty.title: No banks connected
empty.description: Connect a bank to import transactions automatically. You can keep entering cash and other accounts by hand.

connection.expiredNotice: This connection has expired and is no longer syncing. Reconnect the bank to resume.
connection.expiringNotice: Access expires in {{days}} day(s). Reconnect to keep transactions syncing.
connection.noAccounts: No accounts are linked to this connection. They need to be whitelisted in the Enable Banking Control Panel before they will appear here.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect {{bank}}?
disconnectDialog.description: Syncing stops and the bank consent is revoked. The accounts and their transactions are kept, and become editable again.

dialog.title: Connect a bank
dialog.description: You'll be sent to your bank to log in and approve access. We never see your credentials.
dialog.loadFailed: Could not load the bank list.
dialog.whitelistNote: Your accounts must be linked in the Enable Banking Control Panel before they can be synced here. If the connection succeeds but no accounts appear, that step is missing.
dialog.readOnlyNote: Access is read-only — no payment can be made. See our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> and <terms>Terms of Service</terms>.

callbackErrors.missing_state: The bank did not send back enough information. Please try again.
callbackErrors.invalid_state: That connection attempt is no longer valid. Please start again.
callbackErrors.state_expired: The connection attempt timed out. Please try again.
callbackErrors.state_already_used: That connection link was already used. Start a new one.
callbackErrors.bank_declined: Your bank declined the request or the approval was cancelled.
callbackErrors.session_failed: We could not complete the connection with your bank. Please try again.
callbackErrors.no_accounts: Your bank approved access but returned no accounts. They likely still need to be linked in the Enable Banking Control Panel.
callbackErrors.generic: The bank connection could not be completed.

transaction.pendingHint: Not yet booked by your bank. It may change or disappear.
